content.text: The Zone_F3_Z01 temperature rose ~2.0 °C since July 2018, well above the mild drift (~0.2–0.8 °C) seen in all other zones. The cooling/heating setpoints are unchanged, but the VAV_F3_Z01 damper position setpoint increased from ~0.19 to ~0.44, i.e. the controller is modulating more to hold a zone whose setpoints didn't move — consistent with increased local thermal load rather than a sensor drift (a sensor fault would typically not be "corrected" by increasing damper opening, and neighboring zones show no similar drift).
